wiki.title: Robin Kreibich
wiki.extract: Robin G. "Rob" Kreibich (born June 4, 1959) is an American businessman and Republican politician from New Richmond, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 28th Assembly district since January 2025. He previously served 14 years in the Wisconsin State Assembly, from January 1993 until January 2007, representing Wisconsin's 93rd Assembly district.
